profile.headline: Member of Technical Staff at Microsoft

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: designing, building and deploying AI architectures to enterprise customers

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
➢ Engineered a custom LLM validation framework using C# microservices and PowerApps, enabling automated testing of agent response quality and reducing manual verification time for model hallucinations and accuracy.

➢ Architected the plugin infrastructure connecting Microsoft Copilot Studio to C# microservices, enabling seamless front-end integration and real-time data retrieval for personalized shopping experiences.

➢ Designed a scalable Azure-based reference architecture that reduced customer deployment time by 80% for personalized shopping agents.

➢ Implemented feature-flag logic using Power Platform environment variables to decouple testing data from production logic, allowing for rapid iteration of demo experiences without code regressions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
➢ Revamped UI/UX patterns using React/TypeScript, achieving 100% reliability across core customer-facing data ingestion components.

➢ Designed and implemented a process to generate localized Microsoft Excel data ingestion templates using Python and open-source libraries, speeding up the localization process by 78% and reducing costs by 95%.

➢ Streamlined business validation rules for the Carbon, Water, Waste, and Shared data models using C#, reducing data ingestion user errors by 70% and eliminating regressions in downstream services.

➢ Implemented automation to deploy excel ingestion templates via CI/CD pipelines, increasing developer productivity and speed of iteration.

➢ Developed dashboards for Microsoft Sustainability Manager data ingestion and scorecards/goals metric, providing product managers and engineering leaders with more than 20 datapoints to make data-driven decisions.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
➢ Implemented Azure Workbooks and Kusto Query Language (KQL) to build Update Compliance monitoring experiences.

➢ Collaborated with product managers and designers to define more than 30 metrics that would be shown interactively to IT admins in the Windows Update Compliance workbooks.

➢ Explored, analyzed, and aggregated data utilizing Log Analytics and Kusto Query Language.
positions.insights: Skills: Kusto Query Language (KQL) · Microsoft Azure · Data Analysis

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.locationName: Ormond Beach, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
➢ Maintained and debugged codebases for 25+ clients, resolving critical front-end rendering issues and optimizing CSS performance.

➢ Developed more than 25 websites based on mockups provided by the designer.

➢ Deployed staging and production environments for initial website development or major updates.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · WordPress · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Web Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Architect the functionalities of the application based on its purpose.
•	Design a mockup of the user interface.
•	Design MongoDB database collections and documents based on the needs of the application.
•	Develop a single-page application front-end utilizing React.js.
•	Develop, test and deploy back-end in AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Amplify, Cognito and Node.js.
•	Implement marketing strategies that attract potential adopters to the platform.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	WordPress website and landing pages development.
•	Modify content in HTML and CSS. 
•	Maintain and debug PHP WordPress plugins.
•	Add analytics tools to websites and landing pages.
•	Create advertising content in Photoshop. 
•	Implement SEO best practices
